name: Amaya Saki
source:
Saki is the closest friend of [url=/c10661]Tomoka[/url] and one of her classmate.

She doesn't has any interest on [url=/c82665]Kazuki[/url] at first, but she starts liking him because he is very kind with her despite the clichés about the gals.

[spoiler]Like Tomoka, her personality is different depending the route followed but her background story don't change at all.[/spoiler]
